name: Leans toward camera
text: She leans forward toward the camera.
desc: Pressure, intimacy, a confidence. Reads as a lean only on a close shot; staged wide it becomes an approach that does not stop, and can end the shot on a fragment of a face.
needs: a person staged close, with the shot already on them
